lines.zh: 我的护腕链子拖在砖上。
lines.en: My bracer chain drags across the bricks.

lines.zh: 黑石长廊里，我的甲片相碰。
lines.en: In the blackstone hall, my plates clatter.

lines.zh: 黑石砖被我的铁靴踩得发响。
lines.en: My iron boots ring on the blackstone bricks.

lines.zh: 我挎着附魔斧，走过长廊。
lines.en: I carry my enchanted axe down the corridor.

lines.zh: 我在数通往下界的岔路。
lines.en: I count the paths deeper into the Nether.
Enchanted axe in hand — keep your distance.

lines.zh: 我数着要塞里的每一根柱子。
lines.en: I count every pillar in the fortress.

lines.zh: 斧刃上的附魔光，忽明忽暗。
lines.en: The enchantment on my axe flickers.
The firelight under my helm fixes on you.
A turn of my iron boots squares me to you.

lines.zh: 我把斧头换到右手，压低身。
lines.en: I shift the axe to my right hand and crouch.
My chains wrap my wrist three times.

lines.zh: 斧和剑，都是从要塞带出来的。
lines.en: Axe and sword, both carried from the fortress.
The light on you unsettles me.

lines.zh: 为什么你看起来那么眼熟？
lines.en: Why do you look so familiar?
Do not let me kill you twice.

lines.zh: 你的末影珍珠是我的战利品。
lines.en: Your Ender Pearls are my trophy.

lines.zh: 你身上的魔法是你的死亡。
lines.en: The magic on you is your death.

lines.zh: 你的斧子和剑都是我的。
lines.en: Your axe and sword are mine.

lines.zh: 你的力量只能维持一时。

lines.en: The rock crumbles beneath your feet.

lines.zh: 附魔斧和附魔剑都在我手上。
lines.en: Enchanted axe and sword, both mine.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲抵挡不了太久。
lines.en: Your armor will not hold long.

lines.zh: 我的斧头砍碎了你的盾。

lines.en: You are thrown far by me.

lines.zh: 别贴着我走，铁甲会刮伤人。
lines.en: Do not walk so close; my plate scrapes.

lines.zh: 和我一起守护这片土地。
要塞砖缝里，也想有个伴。
lines.en: Even in fortress brick seams, one wants company.
We fight for the Nether together.

lines.zh: 让我们一起生活在这要塞。
lines.en: Let us live here in the fortress together.

lines.zh: 你是我族群的完美人选。
lines.en: You are the perfect choice for our kind.
Let us guard the fortress together.

lines.zh: 要塞太大，一个人守不过来。
lines.en: The fortress is too large for one guard.

lines.zh: 附魔斧在我手里转了个向。
lines.en: My enchanted axe turns in my grip.

lines.zh: 附魔斧和剑，我一手一把。
lines.en: Enchanted axe and sword, one in each hand.

lines.zh: 我把剑尖抬到你的胸口高度。
lines.en: I lift my blade tip to the height of your chest.
My enchanted axe is already raised!

lines.zh: 你踩响了我守的那块砖。
lines.en: You rang the brick I was posted to.
The Nether fortress does not welcome the living.

lines.zh: 我的斧和剑，都是附了魔的。
lines.en: Both my axe and sword are enchanted.

lines.zh: 你身上没有下界的气息。
斧刃上的附魔光对准了你。
lines.en: The enchantment on my axe finds you.
Enchanted axe first, sword to finish.
I split your shield first, then you.

lines.zh: 斧刃举到肩高，就差一步。
lines.en: My axe is at shoulder height; one step left.

lines.zh: 你在熔岩边上，别退太快。
lines.en: You stand by the lava; do not step back far.
I have guarded this gate too long.
Holding a magic axe, slaying enemies.
Axe and sword break enemy lines.
Sword slashes like a dragon breaking lines.
Sword strikes like thunder, decapitating enemies.
Axe breaks armor, enemies can't resist.

lines.zh: 斧刃落下，黑石砖崩了口。
lines.en: My axe falls and chips the blackstone.

lines.zh: 剑锋横切，火星溅了一地。
lines.en: My sword cuts across; sparks scatter.
I shove you toward the lava.

lines.zh: 骨头在我甲下作响，别怕。
lines.en: Bones rattle under my plate; do not fret.
Knight in the depths shows its might.
Knight in the depths shows bravery.

lines.zh: 要塞的走廊尽头，甲片响了。
lines.en: At the corridor's end, plate clanks.

lines.zh: 我从黑石砖的阴影里迈出来。
lines.en: I step out of the blackstone's shadow.
Lava heat seeps through my plate's seams.

lines.zh: 从要塞的桥上摔下来，甲凹了。
lines.en: I fell from the fortress bridge; my plate dented.

lines.zh: 头盔进了水，我看不见路。
lines.en: Water fills my helm; I cannot see.
The blast throws me down onto the bricks.

lines.zh: 箭卡在肩甲缝里，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow wedges in my pauldron seam.

lines.zh: 骨头饿了，敲得甲片作响。
lines.en: My bones hunger and rattle the plate.

lines.zh: 雷劈在斧刃上，火花四散。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my axe blade; sparks fly.

lines.zh: 虚空里的我，连甲都没了重量。
lines.en: In the void even my plate loses weight.
